mapper.select:
select aa.* from( SELECT a.ifcgseq, a.ifcgdelNy, a.ifcgname, (select count(aa.ifcdseq) from code aa where 1=1 and aa.ifcddelNy = 0 and aa.codegroup_ifcgseq = a.ifcgseq) as ifcgseqcount
ORDER BY a.ifcgseq DESC ) aa limit #{rowNumToShow} offset #{startRnumForMysql}

SELECT a.ifcgseq, a.ifcgdelNy, a.ifcgname, a.ifcguseNy
AND a.ifcgseq = #{ifcgseq} order by a.ifcgseq DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO codegroup( ifcgdelNy, ifcgname, ifcguseNy )values( 0, #{ifcgname}, 1 )
